artworks.title: Tobias and the Angel [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an artwork of a celestial scene with a winged figure. The drawing shows a dynamic composition with a central winged figure gesturing forward, holding a staff in one hand. Other smaller figures and a dog are present in the scene. The background features swirling lines suggesting movement or energy. The artwork is created using ink on paper.

artworks.title: Young Woman Holding a Fan
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 49.4 x 35.3 cm (19 7/16 x 13 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the shoulders up. The individual has one hand on their cheek and the other hand holding a walking stick. They have a calm facial expression, with large eyes and a slight smile. Their hair is partly visible under a wide-brimmed hat with ruffles. They wear a garment with ruffled edges and a pearl necklace. The background is plain, directing focus to the person.

artworks.title: Three Cherubs and a Beribboned Staff
artworks.medium: red chalk on blue paper heightened with white chalk; the tow upper cherubs' heads incised for transfer
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three cherubic figures with only their heads and shoulders depicted at various angles on the paper. The top figure has its head tilted back slightly with a gentle smile, the center figure looks downward with soft features, and the lower figure is positioned upside down and appears to be looking downward as well. All three figures have curly hair, drawn with expressive and fluid lines. The sketch focuses on the expressions and contour of the faces. The background is a textured, muted blue color that complements the warm, reddish-brown sketch lines. Additionally, there is a faint, loosely sketched element resembling a staff or scepter in the lower left part of the image.

artworks.title: Max Slevogt
artworks.medium: drypoint and rocker with graphite and white heightening on laid paper [working proof]
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man, shown from the chest up in profile facing right. He has a strong jawline, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, full wavy hair combed back with highlights, and round eyeglasses on his nose. He is wearing a collared suit jacket. The portrait is sketched on paper, focusing on facial features. The background has no distinct detail. The artwork is signed and dated with the name 'MAX SLEVOGT' and '50 JAHRE ALT' inscribed, alongside partially visible text in the lower corners.

artworks.title: The Entrance of a Temple
artworks.medium: etching in brown-black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with classical elements. The imagery features grand, imposing structures that display the classical architecture style, characterized by tall columns with ornate Corinthian capitals. The drawing shows an interior space with an arched ceiling, a stone facade, and an inscription on a plaque that reads "D.O.M." Groups of figures are present in the scene, possibly portraying a narrative moment or procession. The artwork is rendered in a detailed, linear technique that highlights the texture of the stone and the depth of the scene.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, Drawing
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.9 x 17 cm (8 1/4 x 6 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person seated at a table, leaning slightly forward with their left hand resting on the surface and holding a quill or pencil. The individual's facial features include slightly raised eyebrows, a straight nose, and full lips. The person has short hair partially covered by a rounded cap. They are wearing a shirt with ruffled sleeves and a cloak or jacket. The background features an intricately detailed textured pattern.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait with a Spider in the Window
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a table, holding a quill above a sheet of paper. He has a round face with a subtle double chin, pronounced lips, and a furrow in his brow. His hair is covered by a large hat casting a shadow over his face. He is dressed in a voluminous garment with buttons, a ruffled shirt showing. On the table, there is a cloth with bottles, one stoppered. In the background, a window shows a landscape with structures. On the left, there are a skeletal violin and sword, against the wall.

artworks.title: Nicolas de Largillierre
artworks.artist: François Chereau I after Nicolas de Largillierre
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of Nicolas de Largillière, where his upper body is shown. He is seated and positioned at a slight angle, appearing to be indoors near a large ornate window or frame. His facial features display a composed expression, with pronounced cheekbones and a broad forehead, while his hair is voluminous and curly, framing his face. Nicolas wears a voluminous robe that drapes around his shoulders, and under it, part of a white shirt is visible. In his hands, he holds brushes and art tools. The background consists of what appears to be a sketch or easel partially visible behind him, and the stone window or frame is decorated with intricate carvings and inscriptions.

artworks.title: Gertrude van Veen
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 31.7 x 21.4 cm (12 1/2 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a woman's portrait. She is shown from the waist up, slightly facing to the right of the frame. Her facial features include defined eyebrows and full lips, and she has curly hair framing her face. She is wearing a detailed dress with puffed sleeves, a lace-edged collar, and a string of pearls around her neck. Her hand rests on her waist, displaying a bracelet. The background features an ornate frame with inscriptions, artistic tools like a palette and brushes, a naval scene within a smaller frame, and various books and scrolls on tables beneath her portrait.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. James T. Dyke, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a person. The person's upper half is depicted, showing the head and upper torso. They are facing slightly to the right with a direct gaze. The facial features are softly drawn, with delicate eyes and a neutral expression. The person has long hair styled with a portion wrapped on top of the head. The clothing is simple, indicating a blouse or dress with a button or pin on top. The background is undefined, keeping the focus on the person. The artist's signature "Gwen John" is in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Small Oriental Head
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper (a later impression)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper part of a person's body, specifically the head and shoulders. The individual is in profile, facing to the right. The facial features are distinct and sharp, with a prominent nose and closed lips. The hair is styled in a large, elaborate way, possibly a turban or headscarf, adorned with decorative feathers or ornamental elements on top. The person wears a garment with a gentle fold around the neck and shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background is plain, with minimal elements, and the artist’s inscription "CASTIGLIONE GENOVESE" is near the head.

artworks.title: Small Oriental Head
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper (an early impression)
artworks.description: The image depicts the profile view of a person's head and upper torso facing to the right. Their facial features include a nose and closed lips, with an upwards tilt. The person is wearing a turban-style headdress with feathers and possibly a floral element. They are dressed in a loose-fitting garment and have an earring dangling from one ear. In the background, there is plain space with handwritten text that reads "Gio Castiglione Genovese" in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Italian Peasant Woman with a Broom
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a person from the knees up, in a seated or resting posture with one knee raised. The person looks upwards slightly with a contemplative expression. The facial features are distinct, with a furrowed brow and high cheekbones, beneath a head covering that drapes around their head and shoulders. The hair is mostly hidden by the cloth. The person is dressed in an intricately detailed garment, featuring layered and textured fabrics with decorative elements. In their hands, they hold a large bundle of sticks or a thatch, grasped near their chest. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed linework of the figure and their attire.

artworks.title: Deer Resting in Albury Park
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on Whatman laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon line is in the middle, with rolling hills that rise and fall towards the right. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes, resembling watercolor, giving a soft quality to the trees and clouds. The color palette includes muted tones like pale blues, gentle greens, and soft grays. In the foreground, a small herd of deer is depicted. On the left, a group of trees stands tall. In the distance, misty mountains and trees are visible.

artworks.title: Prudence [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person, captured in full body from head to toe. The person is standing with a slight lean, with one hand raised towards the chest and the other resting on the hip. The face is turned slightly to the side, with minimal details for the eyes, nose, and mouth. The hair is long and swept back. The clothing is depicted as flowing robes or drapery, with emphasis on the folds and fluid movement. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands. The background is plain, showing the texture of the paper with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Prudence [verso]
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a full-length figure of a person standing in a slightly turned position with the head turned to the left. The facial features are minimal, and the hair is styled simply. The individual wears draped, flowing garments that suggest a robe or gown, with folds and layers adding volume and texture. The figure's arms are bent at the elbows, holding up a portion of the garment. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain, drawing attention solely to the figure. The artwork is rendered in reddish-brown hues, indicative of a sepia or sanguine sketch on paper.

artworks.title: Head of a Youth
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a person's head and upper part of the neck, slightly turned to the right. The person has defined facial features such as a rounded face, prominent cheeks, and closely drawn eyes and lips. The hair is styled in loose, flowing strands that partially frame the face. The person is not wearing any visible clothing or accessories in the sketch. The drawing is done in a reddish tone on paper, with a background of an empty or plain textured surface.

artworks.title: Two Nudes Fighting
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 7.9 x 4.1 cm (3 1/8 x 1 5/8 in.)
support: 13.5 x 8.9 cm (5 5/16 x 3 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art

artworks.title: Landscape with a Man and a Dog
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a wooded landscape with a figure in period clothing walking along a path with a dog. The trees are detailed with intricate lines, creating a sense of movement and texture. The artwork is in grayscale, focusing on light and shadow. The trees transition from the foreground to the background, creating a tranquil forest scene. The composition is naturalistic with gentle, flowing strokes guiding the viewer's eye.

artworks.title: Sketches of Heads and Hands
artworks.medium: red and black chalks on orange prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a sketch displaying a face, hands, and torso. The face shows detailed facial features like eyes, nose, and lips without hair. It is in a three-quarter view facing slightly to the right. Below the face are two hands, one in the center with curved fingers and the other on the left holding an unseen object. Above the hands is a partially drawn torso at an angle. There is no indication of clothing or jewelry. The background is a neutral-toned surface.

artworks.title: Designs for Palatial Staircases [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural sketches. The drawing shows various sketches of architectural elements and staircases, including perspectives and cross-sections of arches, stairwells, and entranceways with intricate details. The images are rendered in ink on paper, displaying precise and complex lines that suggest a study of architectural design, potentially including ground plan and elevation views of structures.

artworks.title: Designs for Palatial Arches [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural sketches that feature stairs and arches. The drawing shows various studies of architectural elements such as vaulted arches, staircases, and columns. The sketches are rendered in a loose, freehand style, and appear to be explorations or studies rather than finished compositions. Shading and line work are used to convey depth and dimension within the structures.

artworks.title: Prophet and Sybil
artworks.artist: Italian 16th Century, after Jacopo Zanguidi, called Bertoia
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite, heightened with white, on two joined sheets of laid paper, mounted to canvas
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a frieze featuring classical mythological figures in dynamic poses within an ornate architectural setting with floral elements and scrollwork. Cherubic figures assist larger beings in the scene. The drawing is monochromatic with detailed line work and shadowing, creating depth and richness.

artworks.title: A Mythological Scene with Sea Gods
artworks.medium: brown wash and pen and brown ink over graphite, heightened with white, on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows three human figures and a cherub. Two figures are seated upright, while the third reclines on a draped surface. The two upright figures have refined facial features and styled hair, with one possibly adorned with a garland. The reclining figure, also with styled hair, is partially covered, with a focus on her extended lower body and exposed upper body. The figures' clothing is depicted in loose drapes. A small cherub-like figure with wings is engaging with them, holding an object resembling a mirror or tambourine. An additional reclining cherub is next to the third figure. The setting features flowing, expressive lines against an abstract, muted background with no distinct objects or structures.
